chain_words.nuance: requires care, but is usually manageable
tests skill and effort in an interesting way
requires a great deal of time, energy or attention
involving long, hard and tiring effort
so severe that it leaves a person exhausted

explanation: These words all describe something that is not easy to do, moving from a minor complication to an effort that leaves a person completely exhausted.

usage_notes.difference: 'Challenging' describes a task that tests your ability in an engaging way; 'demanding' stresses the amount of time, energy or attention it requires.
